newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms plan initial public offerings.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms plan initial public offerings.

text.p: Korea Network Corp, an affiliate of Kohap Ltd, and Dae Won Chemical Co have applied for initial public offerings, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Wednesday.

Korea Network, a telecommunications equipment maker, plans to offer 496,000 shares at 25,000 won per share and Dae Won, a rubber and plastic products maker, 600,000 shares at 23,000 won, a statement from the board said.
An official at the board said the applications were expected to be reviewed around the middle of August and that, if approved, subscription was likely to be made a month later.
The offerings were expected to be listed on the Korea Stock Exchange in October, he said.
Lead managers are KFB Securities for Korea Network and Ssangyong Investment and Securities for Dae Won.
The two stocks are currently trading on the over-the-counter market, the board statement said.
